messages:
IncidentBot: ALERT: p99 router tail latency spike detected — eu-west-2 ingress (streaming). p95=180ms p99=820ms over last 5m. SLO breached. Paging on-call and posting here :rotating_light:

alice.m: got paged, joining. bridge?

IncidentBot: Auto-bridge created: https://bridge.internal/incident/6388885555 — also attached quick dashboard snapshot (ingress->router tail latency).

alice.m: joining bridge now. initial checks: dashboards show a sharp p99 jump at 01:03 UTC, error rates OK, CPU/GPU not saturated.

ben.s: noticed increased connection queue depth on router-proxy-euw2-1 and -3, high handoff rate between shards. looks like misrouting amplification.

carol_r: running quick heatmap to see hot partitions...

carol_r: heatmap shows a focused spike on partition key range 0x7a..0x9f on euw2-a, traffic amplified ~4x relative to baseline.

alice.m: can we confirm if this correlates with the new routing coalescing policy rollout? I rolled out coalesce-v2 to euw2 earlier today.

ben.s: yes, coalesce-v2 was pushed at 00:30. rolling back that policy locally on a host fixes the tail in my local probe.

dave_ops: I can throttle coalesce-v2 via the config plane. mitigating step: revert policy weighting to coalesce-v1 for euw2. Doing now (will take ~30s to propagate).

infra-bot: Config change applied: routing.policy.coalesce=coalesce-v1 on euw2 (targeted). Change id: cfg-2026031501.

alice.m: monitoring... p99 dropping in 2m window. p99 down to 240ms, p95 stable. Looks promising.

ben.s: stack traces show some router instances were batching keys from the hot partition into oversized fanout groups, which created queue head-of-line delays — combined with coalesce-v2 grouping logic it made tail much worse.

carol_r: digging logs: sample from router-proxy-euw2-3:

```
[01:03:12] router: incoming fanout=128 for key_range=0x7a..0x7f
[01:03:12] kvcache: prefix-hit=true cache-ttl=0ms
[01:03:13] worker: queue_wait_ms=450 p99 backpressure=true
```

alice.m: good catch. mitigation complete for now. creating follow-up ticket for coalesce-v2 correctness and improved canary metrics.

eve-cs: any customer impact? we just got a support ping from a large streaming customer complaining about stutters in eu-west-2.

alice.m: yes — degraded streaming quality for a subset of customers in eu-west-2 for ~12m window. p99 elevated mostly affecting long-tail streaming requests. escalation to CS minimal but notify affected tier-1 customers.

dave_ops: I opened INC-6388885555-CR to track follow-up: rollback root-cause triage, will add unit tests for coalescing logic and routing simulation against hot partitions.

ben.s: temporary workaround idea: add hot-partition bucketing in router to limit max fanout per key-range for future rollouts. logging to follow.

alice.m: plan for incident report: timeline + root cause (coalesce-v2 bug + hot partition amplification), mitigation (rollback to coalesce-v1), customer impact (streaming stutter for subset in euw2), action items (canary improvements, hot-key detection, routing guards).

carol_r: assigning myself and ben for postmortem on coalesce-v2. dave please coordinate rollout freeze for coalesce-v2 until fixes land.

dave_ops: rollout freeze noted. I'll also add a short-term alert: if p99 > 400ms and fanout_per_key > 64 trigger immediate auto-rollback.

IncidentBot: Severity reduced to P1->P2. Incident status: mitigated (routing policy rollback). Incident channel will stay open for postmortem threads.

alice.m: thanks everyone — oncall handing to ben for follow-up. ben, you're the incident lead for the postmortem. I'll update customers summary and ops notes.

ben.s: taking lead. I have the bridge and logs. will coordinate root cause doc.

eve-cs: I'll draft customer communication and post to #customer-updates once you confirm final impact numbers (rough ETA 2h).

alice.m: last check: monitoring shows p99 back to 150-220ms steady. closing handoff.

ben.s: logged timelines and added links: metrics -> https://dash.internal/ingress/6388885555 logs -> https://logs.internal/streams/6388885555. Next: deep-dive + fix PR.

carol_r: +1. closing bridge in 10. :white_check_mark:
